body:
PR #9 (`STORY-79`) round-1 rework is pushed at `d9378cf` (https://github.com/joemooney/aida-host/pull/9), and PR #11 (`BUG-83`) is open at `92d7244` (https://github.com/joemooney/aida-host/pull/11). Received your round-1 review on PR #10 (`STORY-80`, `3f2ba40e`) and implementing the 4 fixes + threshold ruling (40 for slot 2, 30 for slot 3) now.

### PR #9 (`product/story-79` @ `d9378cf`) — all 6 findings resolved:
1. **Stamp keyed on normalized args + compile env:** When an eligible build (`build`, `check`, `clippy`, `test`, `nextest`, `llvm-cov`, `run`; `bench` excluded) exits `0` and `<target>/<profile>/deps/*.d` exists, `finish_ran` writes `<target>/<profile>/.fresh/<hash>.stamp` keyed on `(realpath(ws_dir), realpath(prof_dir), sub_norm, +toolchain, compile_args_without_test_filters, compile_env)`. Output-only flags (`-q`, `--quiet`, `-v`, `--verbose`, `--color`) and flags already resolved into `ws`/`prof` are stripped from `compile_args`; changing `--features`, `--all-targets`, `--bins`, `--lib`, `-p`, `--target`, `RUSTFLAGS`, `CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS`, `RUSTC*`, or `PROFILE` hashes to a distinct stamp (or misses if never built).
2. **Compare against `stamp_ns` instead of `min_ref_ns`:** All `.d` inputs and workspace files are compared against `stamp_ns = os.stat(stamp_file).st_mtime_ns` (with memoized `stat_cache` and a pruned `os.walk` that completes in ~0.24s on `~/ai/aida`), so `edit -> rebuild -> rerun` goes fresh again even when 439 other `.d` files are older.
3. **No history means queue; budget-check `test` & `run`, exclude `bench`:** Missing stamp or missing prior exit-0 `builds.jsonl` record for runtime-executing commands (`test`/`nextest`/`llvm-cov` without `--no-run`, and `run`) always queues; `bench` is excluded from `fresh_eligible()`.
4. **`fresh.lock` fd (`$ffd`) closed in children (`ADR-25`):** `bgwait` runs `"$@" <&0 {ffd}>&- &` when `ffd` is set, and `start_sccache` closes `ffd`, so no child or long-lived test/run binary inherits `fresh.lock`.
5. **No `tee` on stderr:** `bgwait` invokes `"${sig_restore[@]}" env AIDA_CARGO_SLOT_HELD=none "${nice_cmd[@]}" "$REAL_CARGO" "$@"` directly (no `bash -c ... tee`), preserving child TTY (`[ -t 2 ]`) and `SigIgn: 0000000000000000` and eliminating `$acq_file.err`.
6. **Sign `deps/*.d` only:** `deps_sig()` hashes `(basename, mtime_ns, ctime_ns, size)` of `<target>/<profile>/deps/*.d` only (ignoring top-level `<target>/<profile>/<bin>.d` rewritten by `cargo run`), catching silent `-q` compiles without false misses on `cargo run`.

### PR #11 (`product/bug-83` @ `92d7244`, https://github.com/joemooney/aida-host/pull/11) — `BUG-83 ADR-85 SR-21 SR-22`:
- `bin/cargo-reap` (`cargo reap`): dry-run-by-default worktree target reaper (`KEEP (live build)`, `KEEP (pool)`, `KEEP (active <3d)`, `REAP:orphan`, `REAP:pr-merged`, `REAP:pr-closed`, `REAP:stale`), atomic `<dir>.reaping.$$` rename before `rm -rf`, `{event:"reap", ...}` records in `builds.jsonl`.
- `seed_target()` `AIDA_CARGO_SEED_MIN_FREE` (default `40G`) floor before `cp -al` (`cold-low-disk`).
- `check_target_disk()` warning (`<50G` or `<10%`) + optional hard floor (`AIDA_CARGO_DISK_MIN_GIB=15`, `exit 75`), plus `cargo ps` target-disk header and `cargo ps --capacity` `target_free_gib` / `target_free_pct`.
- All specs remain `in-progress` until merge.
subject: REWORK READY: PR #9 (STORY-79 @ d9378cf) + NEW PR #11 (BUG-83 @ 92d7244); working on STORY-80 round-1 fixes
